IaC template CrudApiFunction Environment.Variables.TABLE_NAME (intended !Ref CartTable, no commit changed it)
answer.explanation: Within the window, CrudApiFunction fails on every request with AccessDeniedException for dynamodb:PutItem on table/missing-table. The live TABLE_NAME is "missing-table", while the SAM template sets TABLE_NAME to !Ref CartTable. The function was last modified at 18:24:34Z, two seconds before the window opened, and no commit in the history touches TABLE_NAME, so this is an out-of-band configuration change. The IAM error is a symptom: CrudApiRole only grants PutItem/GetItem/Query on the CartTable ARN, so the wrong table name is denied. The fix is to restore TABLE_NAME to the CartTable reference, not to widen the IAM policy. The Compression function's OUTPUT_BUCKET change (commit 22ac2c5, reverted in d77424d) is outside this window and its live value is correct, so it is not the cause here.
